plan.notes: QUARTER CREDIT HOURS: ABCO Technology is a quarter-system career college; the official catalog publishes every program in 'QUARTER CREDIT UNITS' (the course-table column is labeled 'Units'). All credit values in this plan are quarter credit hours, NOT semester credits. Source: official ABCO Technology 2026-2027 Catalog (effective July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027), https://abcotechnology.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/ABCO-TECHNOLOGY-catalog-2026-2027.pdf . Transcription verified against the catalog PDF layout extraction on 2026-09-30. Award: Diploma, Cisco Certified Network Associate. Program length: 4 weeks; 4.5 quarter credit units required. Catalog prerequisite for ICND001 is 'CT220, CT225 or equivalent technology experience' (the A+ Certification diploma courses); listed in external_prereqs since they are not part of this program. The catalog publishes the complete course list without term subdivisions; the single term below presents the full program in catalog sequence.
